title: Ziyarat of the Prophet on 17 Rabi al-Awwal
intro: The special visitation of Prophet Muhammad associated with 17 Rabi al-Awwal.
description: Read Ziyarat of the Prophet on 17 Rabi al-Awwal with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: Ziyarat of Holy Prophet (sawa) on 17th Rabbi al Awwal

In his book of Zad al-Ma`ad, `Allamah al-Majlisi, within the recommended acts on the Seventeenth of Rabi` al-Awwal(click for aamal); the Holy Prophet’s birthday, says that Shaykh al-Mufid, Shaykh al-Shahid, and Sayyid Ibn Tawus instructed the following Ziarat:
Also recited Ziarat of Imam ali(as)on 17 th Rabial Awal

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu
blocks.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any associate,

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
blocks.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger,
that he is the chief of the ancient and the coming generations,
and that he is the chief of all Prophets and Messengers.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ ٱلائِمَةِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `alayhi wa `ala ahli baytihi al-a'immati alttayyibina
blocks.english: O Allah, send blessings upon him and upon his Household—the Immaculate Imams.
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Friend of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Choice of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Mercy of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Well-Chosen by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Most Beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Selected by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O Master of the Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O Maintainer of justice.
Peace be upon you, O introducer of goodliness.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَعْدِنَ ٱلوَحْيِ وَٱلتَّنْزِيلِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O core of Divine Inspiration and Revelation.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُبَلِّغاً عَنِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O conveyor on behalf of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O light-giving torch.
Peace be upon you, O conveyor of good tidings (to the believers).
Peace be upon you, O warner (against Allah’s chastisement).
Peace be upon you, O he who warns (against violating Allah’s commands).

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُسْتَضَاءُ بِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi alladhi yustada'u bihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Light that spreads luminosity.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa `ala ahli baytika alttayyibina alttahirina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you and upon your Household—the pure, immaculate,
guides, and rightly guided.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ جَدِّكَ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you and upon your grandfather, `Abd al-Muttalib,
and upon your father, `Abdullah.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ امِّكَ آمِنَةَ بِنْتِ وَهَبٍ
blocks.english: peace be upon your mother, ªminah the daughter of Wahab.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ حَمْزَةَ سَيِّدِ ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon your (paternal) uncle, Hamzah, the master of martyrs.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ ٱلعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon your uncle, al-`Abbas the son of `Abd al-Muttalib.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ وَكَفِيلِكَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
blocks.english: Peace be upon your uncle and your guardian, Abu-Talib.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱبْنِ عَمِّكَ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلطَّيَّارِ فِي جِنَانِ ٱلْخُلْدِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `ala ibni `ammika ja`farin alttayyari fi jinani alkhuldi
blocks.english: Peace be upon your cousin, Ja`far the flying in the gardens of the Paradise of Eternity.
Peace be upon you, O Muhammad (the praised).
Peace be upon you, O Ahmad (the more praised).

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi `ala al-awwalina wal-akhirina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah against the past and coming generations,
foremost to the obedience to the Lord of the worlds,
prevailing over His Messengers,
last of His Prophets,
witness over all His creatures,
interceder to Him,
firmly established with Him,
obeyed in His Kingdom,
winner of the most praised qualities,
holder of the most praised honors,
honored by the Lord,
addressee (by Almighty Allah) from behind the (Divine) Veils,
most advanced in position,
and unovertakable.
I greet you with the greeting of him who acknowledges your right (that is incumbent upon us),
who confesses of his shortcoming in carrying out his duty towards you,

blocks.arabic: غَيْرِ مُنْكِرٍ مَا ٱنْتَهَىٰ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
blocks.transliteration: ghayri munkirin ma intaha ilayhi min fadlika
blocks.english: who does not discuss your limitless virtues,
who is sure that you will have more rewards from your Lord,
who believes in the Book that was revealed to you,
who deems lawful all that which you deemed lawful,
and who deems unlawful all that which you deemed unlawful.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ مَعَ كُلِّ شَاهِدٍ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu ya rasula allahi ma`a kulli shahidin
blocks.english: O Messenger of Allah, I bear witness—and I join everyone who bears witness
and also bear witness rather than everyone who may deny it—
that you conveyed the messages of your Lord (flawlessly),
offered your nation good advice,
strove in the way of your Lord,
expounded openly what you were commanded to convey,
stood harm for the sake of Him,

blocks.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلْجَمِيلَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa da`awta ila sabilihi bilhikmati walmaw`izati alhasanati aljamilati
blocks.english: called to the way of Him with excellent wisdom and fair exhortation,
fulfilled the duty with which you were commissioned,
you, verily, were compassionate to the believers,
strong against the unbelievers,

blocks.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱليَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and you worshipped Allah sincerely until death came upon you.

blocks.arabic: فَبَلَغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ اشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: fabalagha allahu bika ashrafa mahalli almukarramina
blocks.english: Therefore, Almighty Allah has exalted you to the most honorable position of the ennobled ones,
to the most elevated place of the intimate servants of Him,

blocks.arabic: وَارْفَعَ دَرَجَاتِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ حَيْثُ لاَ يَلْحَقُكَ لاَحِقٌ
blocks.transliteration: wa arfa`a darajati almursalina haythu la yalhaquka lahiqun
blocks.english: and to the most exalted ranks of the Messengers where none can come up with you,
none can excel you,
none can overtake you,

blocks.transliteration: wa la yatma`u fi idrakika tami`un
blocks.english: and none can even think of obtaining your rank.

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَنْقَذَنَا بِكَ مِنَ ٱلْهَلَكَةِ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi istanqadhana bika min alhalakati
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah Who saved us from perdition through you,
Who guided us off misdirection through you,
and Who lit our darkness through you.

blocks.arabic: فَجَزَاكَ ٱللَّهُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ مَبْعُوثٍ افْضَلَ مَا جَازَىٰ  نَبِيّاً عَنْ امَّتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: fajazaka allahu ya rasula allahi min mab`uthin afdala ma jaza nabiyyan `an ummatihi
blocks.english: O Messenger of Allah, may Allah reward you, for you are His envoy, with the best rewarding that He has ever conferred upon a prophet on behalf of his people
or a messenger on behalf of those to whom He has sent him.

blocks.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ زُرْتُكَ عَارِفاً بِحَقِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya rasula allahi zurtuka `arifan bihaqqika
blocks.english: May Allah accept my father and my mother as ransoms for you, O Messenger of Allah. I am visiting you for I acknowledge your right (that is incumbent upon us),
I confess of your superiority,

blocks.arabic: مُسْتَبْصِراً بِضَلالَةِ مَنْ خَالَفَكَ وَخَالَفَ اهْلَ بَيْتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: mustabsiran bidalalati man khalafaka wa khalafa ahla baytika
blocks.english: I know for sure about the straying off (from the right path) of those who dissent from you and from your Household,
and I admit the true guidance that you follow (and lead to).

blocks.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي وَنَفْسِي وَاهْلِي وَمَالِي وَوَلَدِي
blocks.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi wa nafsi wa ahli wa mali wa waladi
blocks.english: May Allah accept my father, my mother, me, my family, my property, and my sons as ransoms for you!

blocks.arabic: انَا اصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ كَمَا صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ
blocks.english: Let me invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon you in the same way as Allah did send blessings upon you

blocks.transliteration: wa salla `alayka mala'ikatuhu wa anbiya'uhu wa rusuluhu
blocks.english: and so did His angels, Prophets, and Messengers;
such blessings that are consecutive, abundant,

blocks.arabic: لاَ ٱنْقِطَاعَ لَهَا وَلاَ امَدَ وَلاَ اجَلَ
blocks.transliteration: la inqita`a laha wa la amada wa la ajala
blocks.english: continuous, incessant, infinite, and unlimited.

blocks.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ كَمَا انْتُمْ اهْلُهُ
blocks.transliteration: salla allahu `alayka wa `ala ahli baytika alttayyibina alttahirina kama antum ahluhu
blocks.english: May Allah send blessings upon you and upon your Household, the pure and immaculate, as much as you deserve.
O Allah, (please do) make You complete blessings,
Your perfect benedictions,
Your most virtuous boons,
and Your most honorable greetings, salutations,
dignities, and mercy,
as well as the blessings of Your archangels,
your commissioned Prophets,
Your elite Imams,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth,

blocks.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina
blocks.english: and (the blessings of) everyone who glorified You, O Lord of the worlds,
from the past and the coming generations—
make all these pour forth upon Muhammad; Your servant, Your messenger,
Your witness, Your Prophet,
Your warner, Your trustee,
Your firmly established (in truth), Your confidante,
Your elite, Your most beloved,
Your friend, Your choice,
Your notable, Your elect,
Your well-chosen, Your mercy,
the best of Your created beings,
the Prophet of mercy,
the storer of forgiveness,
the leader to goodliness and blessing,

blocks.transliteration: wa munqidhi al`ibadi mina alhalakati bi'idhnika
blocks.english: the savior of the servants (of Almighty Allah) from perdition by Your permission,
the caller of them to Your religion,
the custodian by Your order,
the first Prophet to make the covenant,
and the last Prophet to be sent (to humanity),
whom You have immersed in the ocean of virtue,
in the lofty rank,
in the elevated level,
and in the exalted position;
and whom You entrusted in the pure loins

blocks.transliteration: wa naqaltahu minha ila al-arhami almutahharati
blocks.english: and moved to the immaculate wombs
out of Your kindness to him
and Your compassion to him.
In order to safeguard, to shield,
to protect, and to defend him,
You assigned, out of Your omnipotence, a protective lookout over him
to keep him from the impurities of adultery
and from the defects of fornication;
thus, You raised the sights of the servants through him
and revived the derelict lands

blocks.arabic: بِانْ كَشَفْتَ عَنْ نُورِ وِلادَتِهِ ظُلَمَ ٱلاسْتَارِ
blocks.transliteration: bi'an kashafta `an nuri wiladatihi zulama al-astari
blocks.english: when You removed the screening murk by the light of his birth

blocks.transliteration: wa albasta haramaka bihi hulala al-anwari
blocks.english: and dressed Your Holy Precinct the garments of brightness through him.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا خَصَصْتَهُ بِشرَفِ هٰذِهِ ٱلْمَرْتَبَةِ ٱلكَرِيمَةِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma fakama khasastahu bishrafi hadhihi almartabati alkarimati
blocks.english: O Allah, as You have given him exclusively the honor of this noble rank
and the privilege of this great merit,
(please do) bless him for he fulfilled his covenant to You,
conveyed all Your messages,
fought against the infidels in order to prove Your Oneness,

blocks.arabic: وَقَطَعَ رَحِمَ ٱلكُفْرِ فِي إِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa qata`a rahima alkufri fi i`zazi dinika
blocks.english: exterminated the womb of atheism in order to strengthen Your religion,

blocks.arabic: وَلَبِسَ ثَوْبَ ٱلبَلْوَىٰ فِي مُجَاهَدَةِ اعْدَائِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa labisa thawba albalwa fi mujahadati a`da'ika
blocks.english: and dressed himself the garb of misfortune in order to struggle against Your enemies.

blocks.transliteration: wa awjabta lahu bikulli adhan massahu
blocks.english: Hence, You have given him as recompense for any harm that inflicted him,
any trickery that he faced
from the faction who tried to assassinate him;
a merit that excels all other merits

blocks.transliteration: wa yamliku biha aljazila min nawalika
blocks.english: and due to which he possessed Your abundant gifts.
In return, he hid his sadness,
concealed his grief,
swallowed the pang,

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ يَتَخَطَّ مَا مَثَّلَ لَهُ وَحْيُكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam yatakhatta ma maththala lahu wahyuka
blocks.english: and never did he violate the instructions of Your Revelation.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ صَلاةً تَرْضَاهَا لَهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `alayhi wa `ala ahli baytihi salatan tardaha lahum
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon him and his Household—blessings that You please for them,

blocks.transliteration: wa balligh-hum minna tahiyyatan kathiratan wa salaman
blocks.english: and convey our abundant greetings and compliments to him,

blocks.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي مُوَالاَتِهِمْ فَضْلاً وَإِحْسَاناً
blocks.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihim fadlan wa ihsanan
blocks.english: and give us - from You on account of our loyalty to them - favors, kindness,
mercy, and forgiveness.
Verily, You are the Lord of great favor.
O Allah, You have said to Your Prophet Muhammad—
may Allah bless him and his Household:
“And had they, when they were unjust to themselves,
come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah
and the Messenger had (also) asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to mercy), Merciful.”

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ احْضُرْ زَمَانَ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam ahdur zamana rasulika `alayhi wa alihi alssalamu
blocks.english: I was not present at the age of Your Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَقَدْ زُرْتُهُ رَاغِباً تَائِباً مِنْ سَيِّءِ عَمَلِي
blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa qad zurtuhu raghiban ta'iban min sayyi'i `amali
blocks.english: O Allah, I have visited him desiring, repenting from my ill deeds,
imploring forgiveness of my sins,

blocks.arabic: وَمُقِرّاً لَكَ بِهَا وَانْتَ اعْلَمُ بِهَا مِنِّي
blocks.transliteration: wa muqirran laka biha wa anta a`lamu biha minni
blocks.english: confessing of my having committed these sins although You know them more than I do,

blocks.transliteration: wa mutawajjihan ilayka binabiyyika nabiyyi alrrahmati
blocks.english: and turning my face towards You in the name of Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy—
may Your blessings be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: فَٱجْعَلْنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً
blocks.transliteration: faj`alni allahumma bimuhammadin wa ahli baytihi `indaka wajihan
blocks.english: O Allah, in the name of Muhammad and his Household, (please do) make me illustrious

blocks.transliteration: fi alddunya wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina
blocks.english: in this world as well as the Next World and one of those brought near to You.
O Muhammad!
O Messenger of Allah!
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you!
O Prophet of Allah!
O chief of all created beings of Allah!

blocks.arabic: إِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
blocks.transliteration: inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbika wa rabbi
blocks.english: In Your name do I turn my face towards Allah, my and your Lord,
so that He may forgive my sins,
accept my deeds,
and settle my requests.

blocks.arabic: فَكُنْ لِي شَفِيعاً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
blocks.transliteration: fakun li shafi`an `inda rabbika wa rabbi
blocks.english: Therefore, be my interceder before your and my Lord,
for my Lord, the Master, is the best besought
and You are the best interceder.
O Muhammad!
May peace be upon you and upon your Household.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاوْجِبْ لِي مِنْكَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةَ وَٱلرَّحْمَةَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa awjib li minka almaghfirata walrrahmata
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) confer upon me with forgiveness, mercy,
and sustenance that is outgoing, good, and beneficial from Your Presence

blocks.arabic: كَمَا اوْجَبْتَ لِمَنْ اتَىٰ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّداً
blocks.transliteration: kama awjabta liman ata nabiyyaka muhammadan
blocks.english: in the same way as You conferred upon him who came to Your Prophet, Muhammad, when he was alive,
may your blessings be upon him and his Household,

blocks.transliteration: wa huwa hayyun fa'aqarra lahu bidhunubihi
blocks.english: and confessed of his sins.
Thus, Your Messenger prayed You to forgive him.
May your blessings be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا ارْحَمَ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: faghafarta lahu birahmatika ya arhama alrrahimina
blocks.english: And You did forgive him out of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa qad ammaltuka wa rajawtuka
blocks.english: O Allah, I now put my hope in You, please You,
stand before You,
desire for You other than anyone else,
and hope for Your abundant reward
while I confess of my sins and I do not deny them,
I repent to You from whatever I have committed,
and I seek refuge with You from this position
against the deeds that I have committed

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّتِي تَقَدَّمْتَ إِلَيَّ فِيهَا وَنَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهَا
blocks.transliteration: allati taqaddamta ilayya fiha wa nahaytani `anha
blocks.english: although You, firstly, had introduced them to me as prohibited, warned me against committing them,
and threatened me with Your punishment if I would violate.
And I seek shelter with the nobility of Your Face
lest You impose upon me the situation of disgrace and humility
on the day when the veils will be exposed,
the secrets and scandals will be disclosed,
and the muscles will writhe with fear;
on the day of regret and remorse,
the day of exposing the liars,
the day of the approaching doom,
the day of assembling,
the day of separation,
the day of punishment,

blocks.arabic: يَوْماً كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ الْفَ سَنَةٍ
blocks.transliteration: yawman kana miqdaruhu khamsina alfa sanatin
blocks.english: the day the measure of which is fifty thousand years,
the day of the blowing,
the day on which the quaking land shall quake
followed by oft-repeated commotions,
the day of raising the dead,
the day of exposition before the Fire,
the day when all mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds,
the day when a man flees from his brother,
his mother, his father,
his wife, and his children,

blocks.transliteration: yawma tashaqqaqu al-ardu wa aknafu alssama'i
blocks.english: the day when the earth and the sides of the heavens will split asunder,

blocks.arabic: يَوْمَ تَاتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهَا
blocks.transliteration: yawma ta'ti kullu nafsin tujadilu `an nafsiha
blocks.english: the day when every soul will come pleading for itself,

blocks.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوٱ
blocks.transliteration: yawma yuradduna ila allahi fayunabbi'uhum bima `amilu
blocks.english: the day when they will be relegated to Allah Who will inform them of what they did,

blocks.arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلَىٰ عَنْ مَوْلَىٰ شَيْئاً
blocks.transliteration: yawma la yughni mawlan `an mawlan shay'an
blocks.english: the day when a friend can in naught avail his friend
nor can they be helped
save him on whom Allah will have mercy.
Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful,

blocks.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ ٱلغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَادَةِ
blocks.english: the day when they will be returned to the Knower of the invisible and the visible,

blocks.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ اللَّهِ مَوْلاهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ
blocks.transliteration: yawma yuradduna ila allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi
blocks.english: the day when they will be restored to Allah, their Lord, the Just,
the day when they come forth from the graves in haste,
as racing to a goal
and as locusts spreading abroad,
hastening toward the Summoner—
to Allah,
the day of the event inevitable
when  the earth will be shaken with a shock,
the day when the sky will become as molten copper
and the hills become as flakes of wool
and no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend,
the day of the witness and that whereunto he bears testimony,
and they day when the angels will come rank on rank.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱرْحَمْ مَوْقِفِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ بِمَوْقِفِي فِي هٰذَا ٱليَوْمِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma irham mawqifi fi dhalika alyawmi bimawqifi fi hadha alyawmi
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) have mercy upon my situation on that day (when I will be stopped for interrogation) for my current situation,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱلْمَوْقِفِ بِمَا جَنَيْتُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي
blocks.transliteration: wa la tukhzini fi dhalika almawqifi bima janaytu `ala nafsi
blocks.english: and do not confound me at that situation for the wrongdoings that I have committed against myself.

blocks.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ يَا رَبِّ فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ مَعَ اوْلِيَائِكَ مُنْطَلَقِي
blocks.transliteration: waj`al ya rabbi fi dhalika alyawmi ma`a awliya'ika muntalaqi
blocks.english: O my Lord, (please do) group me, on that day, with Your intimate servants,

blocks.arabic: وَفِي زُمْرَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَحْشَرِي
blocks.transliteration: wa fi zumrati muhammadin wa ahli baytihi `alayhimu alssalamu mahshari
blocks.english: include me with the company of Muhammad and his Household—peace be upon them—
make the Pond of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet) to be my arrival point,
make me a place among the honorable, white-forehead group,
and give me my Record (of deeds) in my right hand
so that I will succeed due to my rewards,
You will make my face white,
You will make easy for me my reckoning,
You will make my pan of the Scale (of deeds) outweigh,
and I will join the triumphant ones
among Your righteous servants
to Your Pleasure and gardens of Paradise.
O God of the Worlds!

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ انْ تَفْضَحَنِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min an tafdahani fi dhalika alyawmi
blocks.english: O Allah, I do seek Your protection lest You may expose me on that day
in the presence of Your creatures because of my sins,

blocks.arabic: او اَنْ الْقَىٰ ٱلْخِزْيَ وَٱلنَّدَامَةَ بِخَطِيئَتِي
blocks.transliteration: aw an alqa alkhizya walnnadamata bikhati'ati
blocks.english: or I may encounter disgrace and regret due to my wrongdoings,

blocks.arabic: اوْ انْ تُظْهِرَ فِيهِ سَيِّئَاتِي عَلَىٰ حَسَنَاتِي
blocks.transliteration: aw an tuzhira fihi sayyi'ati `ala hasanati
blocks.english: or You may make my evildoings outweigh my good deeds,

blocks.arabic: اوْ انْ تُنَوِّهَ بَيْنَ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ بِٱسْمِي
blocks.transliteration: aw an tunawwiha bayna alkhala'iqi bismi
blocks.english: or You may declare my name as loser amongst Your creatures.
O All-generous, O All-generous,
(I beg You for) pardon, (I beg You for) pardon,
(I beg You for) covering (my evildoings), (I beg You for) covering (my evildoings).

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ انْ يَكُونَ فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa a`udhu bika min an yakuna fi dhalika alyawmi
blocks.english: O Allah, I also seek Your protection against including me, on that day,
with the line of the evils
or add me to the row of the wretched ones.
When You shall distinguish between Your creatures
and drive each group –according to their deeds-
to their final abodes in groups,
(please do) line me up, in the name of Your mercy, with the group of Your righteous servants,
and drive me with the group of the Your pious, intimate servants
to the gardens of Your Paradise, O Lord of the Worlds!
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O conveyor of good tidings (to the believers) and warner (against Allah’s chastisement).
Peace be upon you, O light-giving torch.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلسَّفِيرُ بَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha alssafiru bayna allahi wa bayna khalqihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O intercessor between Allah and His creatures.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ انَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلاصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu ya rasula allahi annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati
blocks.english: I bear witness, O Messenger of Allah, that You were light in the lofty loins
and purified wombs.
The ignorance could not stain you with its impurities

blocks.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska min mudlahimmati thiyabiha
blocks.english: or dress you its gloomy garbs.

blocks.arabic: وَاَشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ انِّي مُؤْمِنٌ بِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu ya rasula allahi anni mu'minun bika
blocks.english: I also bear witness, O Messenger of Allah, that I have faith in you
and in the Imams from your Household,
and I believe in all that which you have brought,
satisfactorily and faithfully.

blocks.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ اعْلامُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu ann al-a'immata min ahli baytika a`lamu alhuda
blocks.english: And I bear witness that the Imams from your Household are the signs of (true) guidance,
the Firmest Handle,
and the arguments against the inhabitants in this world.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ نَبِيِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati nabiyyika
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) do not make it the last of my pilgrimage to (the tomb of) Your Prophet—
peace be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: وَإِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي فَإِنِّي اشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي
blocks.transliteration: wa in tawaffaytani fa'inni ashhadu fi mamati
blocks.english: If you decide to grasp my soul, I will bear witness in my death,

blocks.arabic: عَلَىٰ مَا اشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
blocks.english: as same as I have born witness in my lifetime,

blocks.arabic: انَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
blocks.transliteration: annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
blocks.english: that Your are verily Allah; there is no god save You,
alone without having any associate,
that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger,

blocks.arabic: وَانَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ اوْلِيَاؤُكَ وَانْصَارُكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa anna al-a'immata min ahli baytihi awliya'uka wa ansaruka
blocks.english: and that the Imams from his Household are Your intimate servants, Your supporters,
Your Arguments against Your creatures,
Your representatives amongst Your servants,
Your signs in Your lands,
the custodians of Your knowledge,
the keepers of Your secret,
and the interpreters of Your Revelation.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

blocks.transliteration: wa balligh ruha nabiyyika muhammadin wa alihi
blocks.english: and convey to the souls of Your Prophet, Muhammad, and his Household,

blocks.arabic: فِي سَاعَتِي هٰذِهِ وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ
blocks.transliteration: fi sa`ati hadhihi wa fi kulli sa`atin
blocks.english: at this very hour as well as all times,
greetings and compliments from me.

blocks.arabic: وَٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka ya rasula allahi wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: O Messenger of Allah, peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: لاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ تَسْلِيمِي عَلَيْكَ
blocks.english: Allah may not decide this compliment of me to be the last.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت رسول خدا ۱۷ ربیع الاول کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
